name: recordings_visual_identity_undo
title: Undo an image identification
description: Appends a guarded withdrawal of the current exact-image answer, or restore the answer it corrected. Preserves newer and unrelated answers. The durable Undo is separate from its native background picture update, whose status the read reports until it settles.

already_applied.description: True when this undo had already been applied and the call replayed it.

speaker_model_context.description: Compact speaker identity context shared with the model; the full speaker evidence stays in result metadata.
